title: New names refused
summary: A new name that is no identifier, a keyword, taken in the same scope or a macro is refused with the reason; overloading a function or taking a reserved name is done with a warning

rename.error: cannot rename `compute`: `1abc` is not an identifier
cannot rename `compute`: `Point` is already declared in the same scope (${WS}/main.cpp:3)
cannot rename `compute`: `TWICE` is a macro (${WS}/main.cpp:1): it would expand in place of the new name

rename.notice:
Renaming `compute`:
  `other` already names a function in the same scope (${WS}/main.cpp:6): the renamed function overloads it, which fails to build in C or when their parameters are the same

Renaming `compute`:
  `_Compute` is reserved for the implementation
